body.next: No trade record under id "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004" yet. That does not prove the write did not run: a write that is still starting has no record yet. If a write was sent with this id, send the SAME request again with the SAME id ("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004"). It returns the stored outcome, or reports the one still running. It never executes a second time. A refusal of that resend (a conflict or a limit) is an answer about the resend, not about the write: read candle_get_operation again before reporting an outcome. Never send it under a new id: a new id is a second trade. This read asked kind "trade": a launch id has no record there, and a swap id is not read by this tool at all, so replay the swap with its clientSwapId.
